description: Sensori di traffico RER is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Emilia Romagna. Sensori di traffico del Comune di Modena. I dati derivano dal Sistema di Monitoraggio regionale realizzato dalla stessa regione, dalle Province e dall'Anas. Le postazioni sono installate al margine della carreggiata stradale ed alimentate da pannelli fotovoltaici. Viene registrato il numero totale di veicoli assoluti censiti nel mese e la media giornaliera dei transiti. Coverage: Regione Emilia Romagna. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Emilia Romagna. Its tags are anas, postazioni-traffico, rer, traffico, veicoli. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GML, MAP_SRVC, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
